Do you mean:

- Cherly (AI outfit/closet app): I can’t find an official site, but a recent hiring post describes Cherly as an app where you photograph your closet and get AI-built outfits from the clothes you already own. ([reddit.com](https://www.reddit.com/r/UGCconnect/comments/1v82xdr/looking_for_content_creators_in_india_turkey_to/))
- Cheerly (with two e’s): an AI habit and mood coach app for iPhone that combines habit tracking, mood insights, and AI chat. ([apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cheerly-ai-habit-mood-coach/id1516210099?utm_source=openai))

If you can share a link or where you saw “Cherly,” I can confirm the exact app.
